content.title: How to build a winning portfolio like a pro
content.description:
Worried this AI-fueled rally is a bubble waiting to pop? On Trading Pit, Stocks in Translation host Jared Blikre and Trader Talk host Kenny Polcari break down how pros really manage risk, from matching your timeframe and goals to using the S&P 500 (^GSPC) as a core benchmark. They walk through sector rotations in healthcare and utilities, show why charts flagged Lululemon (LULU) and Palantir (PLTR) as “priced for perfection,” and explain the volatility trade-off in names like IonQ (IONQ) versus broader tech ETFs. You’ll learn how to avoid accidental overexposure to giants like Apple (AAPL), use basic technicals and P/E ratios, and keep emotions in check as you build a portfolio that can survive the next round of market turbulence.

For full interviews, highlights, and key insights, check out more from Yahoo Finance Invest.

content.title: How Chipotle & Lululemon are showing a shift in consumer spending
content.description:
Listen and subscribe to Stocks In Translation on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, or wherever you find your favorite podcast.

In this episode of Stocks in Translation, Computer Trading Corporation CEO and President Peter Borish joins host Jared Blikre and Senior Reporter Allie Canal to discuss market divergences and how it is impacting consumers. Borish shares that consumer spending habits are shifting which is evident in brands like Chipotle (CMG) and Lululemon (LULU) showing signs of decline. As essentials like energy and bills continue to climb in cost, there is less room in consumer budgets for these companies and others of similar stature.

Check out the full episode here.

Twice a week, Stocks In Translation cuts through the market mayhem, noisy numbers and hyperbole to give you the information you need to make the right trade for your portfolio. You can find more episodes here, or watch on your favorite streaming service.

This post was written by Lauren Pokedoff
